theorems.name: Submission.tdo_gl_graph_map_lipschitzOn
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (D : Set (Rn n)) (L : ℝ≥0), LipschitzOnWith L f D → LipschitzOnWith (NNReal.sqrt (1 + L ^ 2)) (fun x => q (graphPoint x (f x))) D
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
